title: ESO Guideline 2025 Update: Blood Pressure Management in Acute Ischaemic Stroke and Intracerebral Haemorrhage
shortTitle: ESO BP in Acute Stroke 2025 update

recommendations.text: ESO advises against routine pre-hospital BP lowering in suspected stroke.

recommendations.classNote: Source grading: Low certainty (IVT) / moderate certainty (MT).
recommendations.text: Maintain BP <185/110 mmHg before the intravenous thrombolysis bolus, and <180/105 mmHg during and for 24 h after intravenous thrombolysis and/or mechanical thrombectomy.
ESO recommends AGAINST intensively lowering systolic BP <140 mmHg in the first 24 h after successful mechanical thrombectomy.
Routine use of vasopressors to raise BP in AIS patients with neurological deterioration who are not treated with acute reperfusion therapy is discouraged.

Net clinical benefit of intensive BP lowering in acute ICH remains uncertain; expert consensus supports early systolic BP reduction to <140 mmHg in small-to-moderate haematomas to limit haematoma expansion.
